Consider the following PR description:
SocketType.is_readable() raises UnboundLocalError on non-Windows platforms

#### Description

The `is_readable()` method on socket objects fails with an `UnboundLocalError` when called on non-Windows platforms.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import trio

async def main():
    sock = trio.socket.socket()
    print(sock.is_readable())

trio.run(main)
```

#### Expected behavior

The method should return a boolean indicating whether the socket is readable.

#### Actual behavior

```
UnboundLocalError: local variable 'p' referenced before assignment
```

This appears to affect all non-Windows platforms where the code path uses `select.poll()` instead of `select.select()`.
</pr_description>
